scene_purpose: A moment of visual reflection: the silence after the destruction.
main_subject: Ground-level view across the devastated forest; fallen trunks to the horizon, thin smoke still rising from scattered points.

camera.angle: Ground-level to slightly elevated cinematic wide shot, horizon in the upper third
camera.composition: Heavy debris field crosses the foreground diagonally; isolated burnt snags stand as dark verticals against the pale sky; smoke columns give sparse vertical rhythm; large muted sky as negative space.

lighting.direction: Dim overcast daylight, faintly brighter at the horizon
lighting.intensity_and_character: Dramatic overcast: soft low-contrast light, smoke filtering it further; muted, mournful; the only 'warmth' is ash-brown ground tone.

foreground_elements: detailed shattered trunks and branch wreckage
animation_opportunities: very slow lateral dolly (contemplative, matches s5/s7 pacing)
must_preserve: muted grade with no warm accent
can_simplify: debris chaos to scattered stripped instances + a few hero merged-geometry wrecks
smoke to 4-6 slow additive sprite columns
ground char to terrainColor scorch lerp

engine_mapping.debris: makeForest with fall:1 everywhere + random dir jitter ±0.15 rad for realism; hero foreground wrecks from coniferGeometry({stripped:true}) laid horizontally
engine_mapping.smoke: particles({ n: 400, fall: -0.25, drift: 0.4, color: '#9a9a9a', opacity: 0.18 }) columns at 5-6 seed points
engine_mapping.light: HemisphereLight only, no sun; raise grain slightly in grade for texture
